name: supply-chain-network-planner
description: Governed supply-chain data preparation, network planning, map cards, and Markdown delivery for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Build governed evidence for supply-chain decisions.
interface.longDescription: Discovers and normalizes authorized Workspace data, publishes typed network Resources, evaluates current and candidate networks, and delivers evidence-linked maps and Markdown reports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze the supply-chain decision using the smallest necessary set of source-backed, deterministic planning capabilities.
